subject: Operational reserve refit for renewal — proposed plan
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Operational reserve refit for renewal — proposed plan

Team —

Following our renewal conversation with Lumo last week, I spent the morning working through a small operational refit that achieves two things: (1) keeps their tail latency within the SLA during the morning 09:00–12:00 surge and (2) reduces their effective per-token cost by moving low-priority workloads into a spot-backed pooled tier. High level: we propose reallocating 40 GPUs from their burst pool into dedicated steady slots and adding a 24-GPU dedicated tranche (A100 equivalent) to cover forecasted Q3 growth.

Key ask: I need a short internal OK for the tranche size and the proposed billing cadence so I can present a clean mutual action plan to Emma on Monday.

Highlights from the attached workbook: opreserve_plan_v1.xlsx
- Expected 3-month cost delta: +12% committed spend vs. current burst-led model, but 7–10% lower unit cost due to steady-state efficiency and KV cache hit improvements
- Surge protection: 40 GPUs moved from burst to steady reduces tail violations by ~85% in our sim
- Spot mix: add a 30% spot pool for preprocessing and nightly retrain tasks — estimated ~18% cost saving on those workloads

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal approval on tranche (24 GPUs) and spot policy (30%) by EOD Fri 6/13
2) We offer Lumo a 6-month evaluation with a one-time migration credit (equivalent to 10% of first-month committed spend)
3) Schedule a technical walkthrough with Lumo SE + our infra team the week of 6/23 to lock rollout windows

See capacity-runbook.pdf for the migration checklist and canary plan.

Thanks —
Sergio
Head of Sales, West
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operational reserve refit for renewal — proposed plan

Sergio —

This looks sensible. Two quick things from GTM:
- Pricing: Emma pushed back previously on large step-ups mid-contract. If we move them to +24 GPUs, recommend we split the tranche into 12 + 12 (month 1 and month 4) so the sticker shock is lower and we can tie the second tranche to utilization thresholds.
- Migration credit: ok on the 10% as long as finance can apply it to month 1 invoice instead of a separate refund flow.

I'll flag for the account play that we offer the 6-month evaluation with usage-based fallback (i.e., if their utilization stays <55% across the tranche after month 3, we downscale automatically and pro-rate).

Approve from my side pending engineering sign-off on the canary windows.

—Ben
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operational reserve refit for renewal — proposed plan

Ben/Sergio —

Engineering notes after a quick run: the proposed 24-GPU dedicated tranche is fine but we need to be explicit about kernel/quantization profiles we’ll pin for the steady slots. Two technical asks before we commit the schedule:
1) Canary windows — we can run a three-step canary over 72 hours: 10% traffic -> 40% -> 100% for the new tranche; need agreement on observability signals (p95 token-latency, KV cache hit rate, and gen-fail-rate).
2) Migration fallback — if we detect p95 regressions >20% or gen-fail-rate spike >1.5x we rollback and fall back to burst routing. That needs to be documented in the SOW.

Irene, can you extract the observability dashboards for those metrics and share a short snippet (Grafana link) that we can include in the technical appendix for Lumo?

I'll be available for the Lumo walkthrough during the week of 6/23 — suggest 6/24 10:00 PT.

Laura
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Shaw <emma@lumohealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Lumo Health Billing <billing@lumohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operational reserve refit for renewal — proposed plan

Thanks — appreciate the thoroughness. A few notes from Lumo’s side after reviewing the workbook:

- The staged tranche (12 + 12) makes sense. Can we add a utilization gate at 60% average across the first 30 days before the second 12 kicks in? We want confidence that the extra committed GPUs are producing steady inference load and not just transient spikes.
- Migration credit applied to month 1 invoice is fine. Please confirm how credits will be reflected on the invoice (line-item or overall credit).
- We like the 30% spot pool for preprocessing, but can you confirm whether spot evictions could impact nightly batch rebuilds? If yes, we’d prefer a small persistent fallback to dedicated for the most critical pipelines.

Emma — VP Platform, Lumo Health
